raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

When a LoRA slot is reused, `load_lora_weight_to_buffer` only zeroes the `embed_tokens` / `lm_head` buffers for adapters that have no embedding weights at all. If the incoming adapter has some of them (say just `lm_head`), the zeroing is skipped, so the slot keeps whatever the evicted adapter left in the rest. The next request then runs with another adapter's weights and nothing complains.

It needs `--max-loras-per-batch` smaller than the number of adapters in use, so slots actually get reused, plus adapters that carry embedding / `lm_head` LoRA weights.

I came across this reading `mem_pool.py` and checked it on a live server (Qwen3-0.6B, `--max-loras-per-batch 1`). Adapter X only changes `lm_head`. Adapter Y has `embed_tokens` weights with a zero B matrix, so it should behave exactly like the base model:

| request | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| base | ` Paris. The capital of Italy is Rome...` | same |
| X | garbage (`항ICK鐘 addrYa...`) | same, as expected |
| Y | the same garbage as X | ` Paris. The capital of Italy is Rome...`, equal to base |

## Modifications

- In `LoRAMemoryPool.load_lora_weight_to_buffer`, moved the existing zeroing block (the one the `else` branch already had) in front of the `if lora_adapter.embedding_layers:` check, so it runs for every adapter. No new logic.
- As a side effect it also clears the rank / vocab tail that a smaller adapter doesn't overwrite, which had the same stale-data problem.
- One regression test, added to the existing `test_mem_pool_ep_unit.py`: a rank-4 slot reused by a rank-2 `lm_head`-only adapter. It fails on main (32 stale values left in `embed_tokens`) and passes with the change. `test/registered/unit/lora` is 114 passed.

I checked the overlap-loading path too: the whole load, including this zeroing, runs inside the same stream context, so the order against the weight copies is unchanged.

If you'd rather see the rank-tail clearing as a separate change, I'm happy to split it out.

## Accuracy Tests

Only affects outputs in the reuse case above, where they were wrong before; the table is the check. No model or kernel code changed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

One extra `zero_()` on the slot's embedding / `lm_head` buffers per adapter load, on buffers the load already writes into. By my arithmetic that is a few MB at rank 8 and about 40 MB at rank 64. I haven't measured it; I expect it to be lost next to the weight copy.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

         self.assertNotIn("adapter", pool.eviction_policy.access_order)
 
 
+class TestEmbeddingSlotReuse(unittest.TestCase):
+    """A reused slot must not keep the evicted adapter's embed_tokens/lm_head."""
+
+    VOCAB, HIDDEN, MAX_RANK = 8, 4, 4
+
+    def _make_pool(self):
+        pool = LoRAMemoryPool.__new__(LoRAMemoryPool)
+        pool.num_layer = 0
+        pool.target_modules = {"embed_tokens", "lm_head"}
+        pool.strict_loading = False
+        pool.pin_memory_available = False
+        pool.enable_lora_overlap_loading = False
+        pool.base_hf_config = types.SimpleNamespace(vocab_size=self.VOCAB)
+        pool.lora_added_tokens_size = 0
+        pool.tp_size = 1
+        pool.tp_rank = 0
+        pool.embedding_A_buffer = {
+            "embed_tokens": torch.zeros(1, self.MAX_RANK, self.VOCAB)
+        }
+        pool.embedding_B_buffer = {
+            "embed_tokens": torch.zeros(1, self.HIDDEN, self.MAX_RANK)
+        }
+        pool.lm_head_A_buffer = {"lm_head": torch.zeros(1, self.MAX_RANK, self.HIDDEN)}
+        pool.lm_head_B_buffer = {"lm_head": torch.zeros(1, self.VOCAB, self.MAX_RANK)}
+        pool.new_embeddings_buffer = {}
+        return pool
+
+    def _adapter(self, rank, value, with_embed_tokens):
+        layers = {
+            "base_model.model.lm_head.lora_A.weight": torch.full(
+                (rank, self.HIDDEN), value
+            ),
+            "base_model.model.lm_head.lora_B.weight": torch.full(
+                (self.VOCAB, rank), value
+            ),
+        }
+        if with_embed_tokens:
+            layers["base_model.model.model.embed_tokens.lora_embedding_A"] = torch.full(
+                (rank, self.VOCAB), value
+            )
+            layers["base_model.model.model.embed_tokens.lora_embedding_B"] = torch.full(
+                (self.HIDDEN, rank), value
+            )
+        return types.SimpleNamespace(
+            config=types.SimpleNamespace(r=rank, lora_added_tokens_size=0),
+            layers=[],
+            embedding_layers=layers,
+            added_tokens_embeddings=None,
+            pinned_embedding_layers={},
+            pinned_added_tokens_embeddings={},
+            scaling=1.0,
+        )
+
+    def test_partial_embedding_adapter_does_not_inherit_evicted_weights(self):
+        """A slot reused by a smaller adapter that only has lm_head keeps nothing of
+        the evicted adapter's embed_tokens, and no stale rows past its own rank."""
+        pool = self._make_pool()
+        lm_head_module = object()
+        full = self._adapter(self.MAX_RANK, 1.0, with_embed_tokens=True)
+        partial = self._adapter(2, 2.0, with_embed_tokens=False)
+
+        pool.load_lora_weight_to_buffer("full", 0, full, [], None, lm_head_module)
+        pool.load_lora_weight_to_buffer("partial", 0, partial, [], None, lm_head_module)
+
+        # embed_tokens was not provided by the new adapter: nothing may remain.
+        self.assertEqual(pool.embedding_A_buffer["embed_tokens"][0].abs().sum(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(pool.embedding_B_buffer["embed_tokens"][0].abs().sum(), 0)
+        # lm_head was provided at rank 2: loaded, and the rank tail is clean.
+        lm_a = pool.lm_head_A_buffer["lm_head"][0]
+        lm_b = pool.lm_head_B_buffer["lm_head"][0]
+        self.assertTrue((lm_a[:2] == 2).all())
+        self.assertTrue((lm_b[:, :2] == 2).all())
+        self.assertEqual(lm_a[2:].abs().sum(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(lm_b[:, 2:].abs().sum(), 0)
+
+
